pages.text:
The Gasifier turns solid carbon and Steam into Syngas, with heat (HU, no FE), and only at 800°C or hotter.
- A coal, charcoal or Bio-Coal + 500 mB Steam make 1,000 mB Syngas; Coal Coke 1,500 mB; 4 biomass 250 mB. Each takes 16,000 HU over 10 seconds and leaves Wood Ash a quarter of the time.
- Fuel and Steam in on top, ash out underneath, Syngas out of the right, heat at the back.
- Syngas burns in the Fuel Burner, Firebox Array and Gas Turbine Array (50 HU per mB, up to 1,150°C).

The Fischer-Tropsch Reactor builds Syngas up into liquid fuels with FE and heat: 1,000 mB Syngas make 30 mB Naphtha, 50 mB Light Oil, 50 mB Heavy Oil and 200 mB Water.
- It only works between 200°C and 350°C. Its heat faces take heat only up to 350°C (a thermostat, in the config).
- A catalyst goes in its catalyst slot: Iron Dust lasts 16 batches, Nickel Dust 32.
- Each product has its own face mode (Naphtha, Light Oil, Heavy Oil, Water); Output faces give out all four.
- Speed and Energy upgrades.
